digest.component_or_area: dependency advisory gating and response workflow
propositions: Committed lock pins transitive dependencies, causing any published advisory on pinned version to block all in-flight changes regardless of their code changes
pip-audit gate cannot distinguish between reachable and present dependencies, and retry logic only handles DB-unreachable failures, making recheck non-functional for real findings
constraint-dependencies can only narrow constraints and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output, but this is commonly misinterpreted as proof upgrade is impossible
Advisory response must be routed by lane: Gerrit verify blocks only changes touching dependency map, scheduled main blocks releases, preventing unrelated changes from being falsely red

override-dependencies is the correct instrument to patch upstream caps when evidence (upstream fix and verified compatibility) exists, and must carry REMOVE-WHEN condition to prevent stale suppressions
Severity bar of CRITICAL/HIGH fail, MEDIUM warns, LOW tracked, with unrated advisories treated as HIGH, must be applied consistently across all lanes with documented fallback behavior
